description: A modern reactive framework for fluid, dynamic web apps.
author: Adebola Akomolafe

scripts.test: pnpm --filter retend-test-suite exec vitest run && pnpm --filter retend-oxlint-plugin run test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter retend-test-suite exec vitest run --reporter=verbose && pnpm --filter retend-oxlint-plugin run test
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && node scripts/install-playwright-browsers.mjs && pnpm run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build-core && pnpm run build-web && pnpm run build-web-devtools && pnpm run build-ssg && pnpm run build-utils && pnpm run build-gpui
scripts.previews: cp README.md packages/retend/README.md && pnpm dlx pkg-pr-new publish './packages/retend' './packages/retend-web' './packages/retend-web-devtools' './packages/retend-server' './packages/retend-start' './packages/retend-utils' './packages/retend-oxlint-plugin' './packages/retend-gpui'
